verses.text: Joshua gathered all Israel’s tribes at Shechem. He called the elders, family heads, judges, and officers, and they stood before God. 👥
Joshua told the people, ‘Yahweh, Israel’s God, says: “Long ago your ancestors lived beyond the River—Terah, Abraham and Nahor’s father. They served other gods. 📜
‘“I took your ancestor Abraham from beyond the River, led him all through Canaan, grew his family, and gave him Isaac. 🗺️
‘“I gave Isaac Jacob and Esau. I gave Esau Mount Seir to possess, while Jacob and his children went down to Egypt. 👣
‘“I sent Moses and Aaron, brought plagues on Egypt, and afterward led you out. 🐸
‘“I brought your ancestors out of Egypt. You came to the sea, and the Egyptians chased them there with chariots and horsemen. 🌊

‘“They cried out to Yahweh, and he put darkness between you and the Egyptians. He brought the sea crashing over them and covered them. You saw what I did to Egypt. Then you lived in the wilderness for many days. 🌊
‘“I brought you into the Amorites’ land east of the Jordan. They fought you, but I handed them over to you. You took their land, and I wiped them out ahead of you. ⚔️
‘“Then Balak son of Zippor, Moab’s king, got up to fight Israel. He sent for Balaam son of Beor to curse you, 👑
‘“but I wouldn’t listen to Balaam. He blessed you instead, and I rescued you from Balak. 🙏
‘“You crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho. The people of Jericho fought you—the Amorites, Perizzites, Canaanites, Hittites, Girgashites, Hivites, and Jebusites—but I handed them over to you. 🏰
‘“I sent hornets ahead of you. They drove out those people and the two Amorite kings—not by your sword or your bow. 🐝
‘“I gave you land you never worked and towns you never built. Now you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves you never planted.”’ 🍇
Joshua continued, ‘So now honor Yahweh and serve him sincerely and faithfully. Get rid of the gods your ancestors served beyond the River and in Egypt, and serve Yahweh. 🙏

‘If serving Yahweh seems wrong to you, choose today whom you’ll serve: the gods your ancestors served beyond the River, or the Amorite gods of the land where you live. But me and my household—we’re serving Yahweh.’ 🤝
The people answered, ‘We would never leave Yahweh to serve other gods! 🙅
‘Yahweh our God brought us and our ancestors up from Egypt, out of slavery. He did those huge signs right before our eyes and protected us all along the way, among every people we passed through. 🛡️
‘Yahweh drove out all the peoples before us, including the Amorites who lived here. So we’re serving Yahweh too—he’s our God.’ 🙏
Joshua told the people, ‘You can’t serve Yahweh; he’s holy and jealous. He won’t overlook your rebellion or your sins. ⚠️
‘If you abandon Yahweh and serve foreign gods, he’ll turn against you and bring trouble, wiping you out after doing good for you.’ ⚖️
The people told Joshua, ‘No—we will serve Yahweh.’ ✅
Joshua said, ‘You’re witnesses against yourselves: you chose Yahweh for yourselves, to serve him.’ They said, ‘We’re witnesses.’ 👥
Joshua said, ‘Then get rid of the foreign gods among you and turn your hearts toward Yahweh, Israel’s God.’ ❤️
The people told Joshua, ‘We will serve Yahweh our God and listen to what he says.’ 🙏
That day Joshua made a covenant with the people and set down rules and laws for them at Shechem. 📜
Joshua wrote these words in God’s law book. Then he took a large stone and set it up under the oak by Yahweh’s sanctuary. 🪨
Joshua told everyone, ‘Look, this stone will stand as a witness against us. It heard every word Yahweh said to us. It will be a witness against you if you deny your God.’ 🪨
Then Joshua sent the people off, each one back to their own inheritance. 🏡
After all that, Joshua son of Nun, Yahweh’s servant, died at 110 years old. 🕊️
They buried him within the border of his inheritance at Timnath-serah in Ephraim’s hill country, north of Mount Gaash. 🪦
Israel served Yahweh all through Joshua’s life and through the lives of the elders who outlived Joshua and knew all the work Yahweh had done for Israel. 📜

They buried Joseph’s bones, which Israel’s people had brought up from Egypt, at Shechem, in the plot Jacob bought from Hamor’s sons for one hundred pieces of silver. That land became Joseph’s descendants’ inheritance. 🪦
Eleazar son of Aaron also died. They buried him on the hill given to his son Phinehas in Ephraim’s hill country. 🕊️
